evidence.zh: 与基线版本 v0.16.1 对比：manifest 声明无新增 dsh.bundle 或 dsh.client 声明，无升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: Compared with baseline version v0.16.1: no new dsh.bundle or dsh.client declarations in the manifest, with no auto-activation risk on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不会给安全插件追加必需服务导致其永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration and will not append required services to security plugins that would cause them to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否自行启动服务或监听端口：插件复用宿主 webServer 注册路由（/sidebar/api、/sidebar/upload、/sidebar/file、/sidebar/html、/sidebar/bundle、/sidebar/ws/terminal 等），未自建监听；所有路由均叠加与宿主 /api 网关一致的浏览器信任围栏（src/trust-fence.ts，回环或受信主机 + Origin 校验），并明确标注该围栏是可达性策略而非认证层。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own services or listens on ports: the plugin reuses the host webServer to register routes (/sidebar/api, /sidebar/upload, /sidebar/file, /sidebar/html, /sidebar/bundle, /sidebar/ws/terminal, etc.) and does not create its own listeners. All routes additionally apply a browser trust fence consistent with the host /api gateway (src/trust-fence.ts, loopback or trusted hosts + Origin validation), and explicitly note that the fence is a reachability policy, not an authentication layer.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器与 HTML 预览默认启用 iframe 沙箱（不透明源、无同源权限、拒绝危险协议与回环地址），关闭沙箱为用户显式设置项且默认关闭；HTML 路由额外附加 CSP sandbox 指令与 no-referrer、nosniff 头作为纵深防御。
checked_items.en: Browser and HTML preview enable iframe sandbox by default (opaque origin, no same-origin permissions, dangerous protocols and loopback addresses rejected); disabling the sandbox is an explicit user setting and is off by default. The HTML route additionally attaches a CSP sandbox directive along with no-referrer and nosniff headers as defense in depth.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证，运行时结论仅依据静态与语义分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed; runtime conclusions are based solely on static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅复用宿主路由并叠加信任围栏；宿主 webserver 无认证层属 dsh 生态固有风险，不由本插件引入或扩大，不适用独立判定。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; it only reuses host routes and applies a trust fence. The lack of an authentication layer in the host web server is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced or expanded by this plugin; no independent judgment applies.

summary.zh: 通过 — 包声明与清单一致，插件身份与任务卡匹配，未发现名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: Passed — package declaration is consistent with the manifest, plugin identity matches the task card, and no name impersonation or identity anomalies were found.

summary.zh: 通过 — 33 条静态规则命中全部人工逐条复核，均判定为良性、测试或文档类，无成立发现。
summary.en: Passed — all 33 static rule hits were manually reviewed one by one and judged benign, test, or documentation related, with no valid findings.

summary.zh: 通过 — 未发现恶意安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或外发通道。
summary.en: Passed — no malicious install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reading, or exfiltration channels were found.

summary.zh: 通过 — 9 个模型工具描述与模型面文档（AGENTS.md）经语义审查，未发现提示词注入。
summary.en: Passed — the 9 model tool descriptions and model-facing documentation (AGENTS.md) were semantically reviewed, and no prompt injection was found.

summary.zh: 不适用 — 未做动态沙箱验证（平台未提供动态探测产物）。
summary.en: Not applicable — no dynamic sandbox verification was performed (the platform did not provide dynamic detection artifacts).

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（context 目录无 l4-sandbox.json，平台未提供动态探测产物），运行时行为结论仅依据静态与语义分析。

插件声明 dsh.bundle.patch（config-patch）与 dsh.client（client-bundle）元能力；提供终端、Git、文件读写、侧边栏浏览器、侧边对话、后台任务视图等能力，能力与声明业务自洽。

全部 33 条机械规则命中经逐条人工裁决均为良性（涉及规则：DSH-X07、DSH-X10、DSH-P01、DSH-X05、DSH-C05、DSH-C01、DSH-X02、DSH-X03），未产出发现项。

与基线版本（v0.16.1）相比，本版侧重终端固定、侧边对话与自由窗口等 UI 功能增强，未见新增恶意能力或外联面。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json in the context directory, and the platform did not provide dynamic detection artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based solely on static and semantic analysis.

The plugin declares the dsh.bundle.patch (config-patch) and dsh.client (client-bundle) meta-capabilities. It provides terminal, Git, file read/write, sidebar browser, side chat, and background task view capabilities, which are self-consistent with the declared business.

All 33 mechanical rule hits were manually adjudicated one by one and are benign (rules involved: DSH-X07, DSH-X10, DSH-P01, DSH-X05, DSH-C05, DSH-C01, DSH-X02, DSH-X03), with no findings produced.

Compared with the baseline version (v0.16.1), this version focuses on UI feature enhancements such as terminal pinning, side chat, and free-floating windows, with no new malicious capabilities or outbound surfaces observed.
